y-m-17-04.title: Ukwahlula iimabula ngomlinganiselo we-3 : 2, inani elipheleleyo kufuneka libe njani?
y-m-17-04.topic: Ukwabelana ngokulinganayo: ukwahlula ngomlinganiselo neemeko zenani elipheleleyo
y-m-17-04.goal: Vavanya ibango elithi 'ukuba inani elipheleleyo lingumangqabangqaba, alinakwahlulwa nge-3 : 2' ngomzekelo ochasayo, uze ufumane imeko yenani elipheleleyo apho linokwahlulwa ngomlinganiselo.
y-m-17-04.material: Ufuna ukubeka iimabula kwiBhokisi 가 neBhokisi 나. y-m-17-01.title: Kufuneka ndizobe i-3 km kwimaphu ibe nde kangakanani?
y-m-17-01.topic: Isikali: umlinganiselo wobude kwimaphu nobude bokwenyani
y-m-17-01.goal: Sebenza ukuba isikali sidibanisa ubude kwimaphu nobude bokwenyani ngayiphi indlela ukufumana impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wenze iibini ezininzi (ubude kwimaphu, isikali) ezihambelana nobude bokwenyani obufanayo.
y-m-17-01.material: Ufuna ukuzoba indlela yokuhamba ngaphambi kwesikolo kwimaphu. Ezantsi kwimaphu, isikali '1 : 50000' (enye ukuya kwamashumi amahlanu amawaka) sibhaliwe. Oku kuthetha ukuba i-1 cm kwimaphu yi-50000 cm ebomini bokwenyani, kwaye yonke imaphu inyuswe ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. I-1 km yi-100000 cm. UMina wasombulula 'Ndifanele ndizobe ii-cm ezingaphi kwimaphu kwindlela eyiyi-3 km ngokwenyani?' ngolu hlobo lungezantsi.
y-m-17-01.thinking.1: Ukukhetha iindlela zokuhlola ukuba isiphumo sinengqiqo
y-m-17-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuba isikali (umzekelo 1 : 50000) ngumlinganiselo wobude kwimaphu nobude bokwenyani
y-m-17-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweeyunithi zobude (1 km = 100000 cm)
y-m-17-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sikaMina.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga isiphumo kuqala. Kulungile ukuba ubude bokuzoba kwimaphu buthi bude kakhulu kunobude bokwenyani obuyi-300000 cm?
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa intsingiselo yesikali, 'i-1 cm kwimaphu yi-50000 cm ebomini bokwenyani,' njengoko injalo, uze ubhale ngokulandelelana ukuba ii-2 cm nee-3 cm kwimaphu zingaphi ii-cm ebomini bokwenyani.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.1: I-1 cm kwimaphu yi-50000 cm ebomini bokwenyani, ngoko (ubude kwimaphu) = (ubude bokwenyani) × 50000.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko indlela kufuneka izotywe kwimaphu njenge-15000000000 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.explain: Impazamo iqala kumgca 2. Isikali 1 : 50000 sithetha ukuba ubude bokwenyani buphindwe ngamaxesha angama-50000 kunobude kwimaphu, ngoko ukufumana ubude kwimaphu kufuneka wahlule ubude bokwenyani ngo-50000, hayi ukuphindaphinda ngo-50000. Ukubala komgca 3 kulandela umgca 2 ngoko ukubala ngokwako kuchanekile kodwa isiphumo siyamangalisa, kwaye umgca 4 awulunganga ngesizathu esifanayo. Xa kusonjululwe ngokuchanekileyo, kuzotywa njenge-6 cm kwimaphu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.prompt: Ziziphi iimhlolo ezikunceda uqaphele ukuba isiphumo sikaMina siyamangalisa? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwinketho nganye, thelekisa '(ngaba olu hlolo lungakuvumela uxele ukuba ingcinga ayilunganga, okanye luphinda nje ingcinga efanayo?)'.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.1: Guqula i-15000000000 cm efunyenwe nguMina ibe zi-km, uze ucinge ukuba bububude obunokuzotywa kwimaphu enye na.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.a: Cinezela ukubala okufanayo kwikhaltyuleyitha kanye ngakumbi ubone ukuba lifika ixabiso elifanayo nelokuqala
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba ubala ngengcinga efanayo, ixabiso elifanayo liphuma kwakhona. Ukuba ukubala kuchanekile nokuba ingcinga (ikhweshini) ichanekile zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.b: Inani likhulu kakhulu, ngoko ukubhala iyunithi nge-km kuphela kuyalenza lichaneke
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba utshintsha iyunithi kuphela, inani olibhalayo liyatshintsha kodwa ubude buhlala bunjalo. I-15000000000 cm yi-150000 km, ende kakhulu ukuzotywa kwimaphu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.c: Bhala ngokulandelelana ukuba ii-1 cm, ii-2 cm, nee-3 cm kwimaphu zingaphi ii-cm zokwenyani
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba uchaza intsingiselo yesikali kwisivakalisi, ungabona ukuba leliphi icala likhulu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.d: Sebenzisa ingqiqo eqhelekileyo ubuze ukuba ubude buzotywe kwimaphu bunokuba bude kunobude bokwenyani
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.d: Uhlola ukuba isiphumo sinengqiqo ngengcamango esisiseko yokuba imaphu yimizobo encinciweyo yento yokwenyani.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba uchaza intsingiselo yesikali njenge-1 cm → 50000 cm kunye ne-2 cm → 100000 cm, okanye ujonge isiphumo ngengqiqo eqhelekileyo yokuba imaphu kufuneka ibe ncinci kunokwenyani, ungaxela ukuba icala lokuphindaphinda alikho kakuhle. Ukwenza ukubala okufanayo kwakhona kunokuphinda impazamo efanayo.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, ucinga ngokuchanekileyo, ufuna ukuzoba indlela eyiyi-2 km ngokwenyani njengee-cm kwimaphu (inani lemvelo elisuka kwi-4 ukuya kwi-20). Yenza izikali ezimbini '1 : b' onokuzisebenzisa, ngobude obumbini obahlukeneyo kwimaphu.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala khetha a, uze ucinge ukuba i-1 cm kwimaphu kufuneka ibe zi-cm ezingaphi zokwenyani ukuze ii-cm ezingu-a zidibane zibe yi-200000 cm. Ixabiso elo yi-b.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.hint.1: Emva kokukhetha a no-b, hlola ngokubuyela umva ukuba ii-cm ezingu-a kwimaphu ziba yi-200000 cm ebomini bokwenyani, uze uphinde uzame kwakhona nge-a eyahlukileyo.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Ubude kwimaphu linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-4 cm ukuya kwi-20 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Ubude kwimaphu a kufuneka bube linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-4 ukuya kwi-20.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c2: I-□ (b) yesikali kufuneka ibe linani lemvelo.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Ii-cm ezingu-a kwimaphu zimele i-2 km zokwenyani (200000 cm).
y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Ii-cm ezingu-a kwimaphu azibi yi-200000 cm ebomini bokwenyani. Hlola kwakhona ukuba i-1 cm kwimaphu yi-cm ezingaphi zokwenyani.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.explain: umz. Kwi-4 cm yi-1 : 50000, kwi-5 cm yi-1 : 40000, kwi-8 cm yi-1 : 25000, kwaye kwi-10 cm yi-1 : 20000. Nokuba ziyi-2 km ezifanayo, okukhona uzizoba zide kwimaphu, kokukhona i-□ yesikali kufuneka ibe nci (imaphu ecacileyo ngakumbi).

y-m-17-02.title: Ukuba usebenzisa ikhuphoni ezimbini, ifana nokunciphisa kwe-30%?
y-m-17-02.goal: Vavanya ingcamango yokuqala yokudibanisa amazinga okunciphisa ngemizekelo yamanani, hlaziya isigwebo sakho nokuzithemba ixesha ngalinye xa kuphuma ulwazi olutsha, uze uchaze ukuba iipesenti zibhekisa kumgangatho muni.
y-m-17-02.material: Evenkileni ye-intanethi kukho ikhuphoni ezimbini. Ikhuphoni 가 ithi '20% ukunciphisa ixabiso langoku' kwaye ikhuphoni 나 ithi '10% ukunciphisa ixabiso langoku,' kwaye 가 no-나 zinokusetyenziswa zombini enye emva kwenye. UMinseo uthe, "20% kunye ne-10% kufana nokunciphisa kwe-30% kunye!" Amaxabiso orhwebo onke ngamanani emvelo (won) makhulu kune-0, kwaye sebenzisa kuphela amaxabiso aphuma ngqo nge-won.
y-m-17-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlela oko umzekelo omnye ukuxelayo noko ungakuxeleli
y-m-17-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yepesenti (izinga xa inani lesiseko li-100)
y-m-17-02.prereq.1: Ukufumana ixabiso elinciphisiweyo ukusuka kwixabiso eliqhelekileyo nezinga lokunciphisa
y-m-17-02.s.s1.prompt: Hlola ukuba isibakala sikaMinseo sichanekile ngokukhetha ingcinga yakho ixesha ngalinye xa kuphuma ulwazi olutsha.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, wahlula '(oko ungakuthi ngolwazi olwaziwayo kuphela ngoku)' kwi-'(oko ungekakwazi).'
y-m-17-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela ingcinga oyikhethileyo kwinyathelo langaphambili ihambelana ngayo nolwazi olutsha, uze uthi ukuzithemba kwakho kukhule okanye kuncipha.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ixabiso eliqhelekileyo alikaxelwa. Kukho kuphela isibakala sikaMinseo nemithetho yekhuphoni.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Khetha eyona isondele koko ucinga ngoku.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Akukabikho bungqina, ngoko nayiphi ingcinga ilungile njengoqikelelo lokuqala. Ngoku masifake inani siliqwalasele.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zibonakala zifana. Kuba 20% kunye ne-10% yenza i-30%
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lo ngumbono wokudibanisa amazinga okunciphisa. Awukabuzi ukuba i-10% yesibini yi-10% yantoni.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqaphele ukuba isiseko sokunciphisa kwesibini siyatshintsha.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Andikwazi ukugweba kuba andiwazi ixabiso eliqhelekileyo. Ndifuna ukufaka inani ndibale
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uvumile oko ungakwaziyo waza kuqala wafumana indlela yokuvavanya.
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndibale ngezicathulo zemidlalo ezixabiso lazo eliqhelekileyo li-10000 won. Ngekhuphoni 가, isaphulelo se-20% senza i-8000 won, kwaye emva koko ngekhuphoni 나, isaphulelo se-10% senza i-7200 won. Isaphulelo esinye se-30% senza i-7000 won.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-7200 won ikufutshane ne-7000 won, ngoko ibango likaMinseo lichanekile kakhulu
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 'Ayafana' kunye 'nayafana kancinci' kwahlukile. Kufuneka ucinge ngendlela yokubona umahluko we-200 won.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Uchaze ngokujonga ulwakhiwo apho ulandelelwano lwabaphindaphindi lutshintsha khona.

y-m-17-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba amanzi ayakhukhumala, awukwazi ukulinganisa ukuphakama okunyukileyo, yaye ukuba ilitye liphuma emanzini, loo nxalenye ayingeni kukubala. Kufuneka uyisebenzise kuphela xa ilitye lingaphantsi kwamanzi ngokupheleleyo.
